##### Project general facts

Creek Edge by Emaar is a waterfront residential development on Creek Island in Dubai Creek Harbour. The project comprises two towers of 40 and 20 floors, connected by a landscaped leisure podium above the waterfront promenade. It offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments designed to make the most of the surrounding Creek views, combining contemporary architecture with a private, nature-inspired setting.

The development benefits from its waterfront location and landscaped leisure podium, with direct access to the promenade along Creek Island. Its two elegant towers overlook Dubai Creek, offering residents a setting that combines urban living with waterfront scenery.

The residences feature contemporary finishes, with careful attention to materials, fittings, and interior details. The kitchens are unequipped, and the apartments are offered unfurnished, giving homeowners the flexibility to personalise their living spaces.

##### Location description and benefits

Creek Edge is located on Creek Island in Dubai Creek Harbour, north of Downtown Dubai along the historic Dubai Creek. The area is known for its waterfront setting and panoramic views of Dubai’s skyline, including the iconic Burj Khalifa.

Dubai Creek Harbour is a master-planned waterfront district offering a mix of residential properties, retail, leisure, and community spaces. Creek Island features an integrated transport network, while access via Festival City, Ras Al Khor Road, and the nearby Al Jaddaf floating bridge connects the area with other parts of Dubai.

The wider development is designed to become a prominent part of Dubai’s evolving skyline, with Dubai Creek Tower planned as a landmark at its centre. The district combines waterfront living, open views, and urban conveniences in a contemporary community setting.
